title: Very Thin, ok for a child's bed
text:
Very Thin, ok for a child's bed. This queen quilted mattress I'll be using for a guest bedroom that will not be used much.
I washed this in warm water put it in the dryer, and it come out good. The quilting seemed to puff up more after washing.
I Would not use this mattress cover for everyday, as I do not think it would last long .
It’s Very thin, although soft.
The top Is polyester , not sure what the bottom is, but it's like a paper type of material !
It would be ok for a child's bed.
The pockets are deep.

For this low price it will cover and somewhat protect a mattress , but as I said , I did not think it will last long with frequent Washing and use..
